description: This script performs database migration benchmarking for Apache Superset, including importing migration scripts, extracting modified tables, finding models, and running upgrade/downgrade cycles with sample data.

methods.name: import_migration_script
methods.description: Imports a migration script as a module from a given filepath.

methods.name: extract_modified_tables
methods.description: Extracts table names being modified in a migration script by analyzing source code patterns.

methods.name: find_models
methods.description: Finds all SQLAlchemy models involved in a migration script, including those referenced via foreign keys, and sorts them topologically.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main CLI command that runs the migration benchmarking process, including optional data sample creation and cleanup.
